en.title: 3 Types of Kofta: Breaded Kofta, Rice Kofta & Hati Kofta
en.intro: You can freeze the kofta on foam plates with a plastic bag between layers to stop them sticking. Let them come to room temperature before cooking.

steps.n2: Mix the minced meat with the cooked rice, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
steps.n3: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
steps.n4: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
steps.n5: Dip the kofta in flour, then in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the breadcrumbs, flour, and starch mixture.
steps.n6: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
steps.n8: Mix the minced meat with the ground rice, minced onion, garlic, mixed herbs, salt, pepper, cumin, ground coriander, and sugar.
steps.n9: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
steps.n10: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
steps.n11: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
steps.n13: Mix the minced meat with the washed and drained bulgur, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
steps.n14: Knead the mixture well for about 10 minutes until it holds together.
steps.n15: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
steps.n16: Grill the kofta on a grill pan, over charcoal, or in the oven until golden.

legacySteps: Making the breaded kofta:
Mix the minced meat with the cooked rice, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
Dip the kofta in flour, then in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the breadcrumbs, flour, and starch mixture.
Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
Making the rice kofta:
Mix the minced meat with the ground rice, minced onion, garlic, mixed herbs, salt, pepper, cumin, ground coriander, and sugar.
Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
Making the hati kofta:
Mix the minced meat with the washed and drained bulgur, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
Knead the mixture well for about 10 minutes until it holds together.
Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
Grill the kofta on a grill pan, over charcoal, or in the oven until golden.
